Let your skills & strength shine Admin / HR / WHSE 
Bowhill Engineering is growing, and we're looking for capable, organised and proactive people to join our team to support Admin, HR & WHSE. 
You may come from an Administration background, have experience in Human Resources, be passionate about Workplace Health & Safety, or bring a combination of all three. What matters most is your ability to keep things organised, support our people, and help our business operate efficiently. 
We have opportunities across Administration, HR and WHSE functions, with responsibilities tailored to suit the skills and experience of the successful applicants. 
Whether you're looking to broaden your career, develop new skills, or bring your existing expertise into a supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you. 

About the Role 
In any of these roles, you'll become an important part of our team, providing administrative and operational support across a range of business functions. 

Depending on your experience and interests, your responsibilities may include: 
Administration Support 
-Reception and general office administration
-Calendar and appointment coordination
-Document preparation and record management
*Support the business wholistically with administration requirements
-Plan, prep and coordinate employee & visitor engagement activities & events 

Human Resources Support 
-Payroll processing assistance and backup
-Recruitment and onboarding coordination
-Employee records administration
-Performance appraisal coordination
-Employee recognition and wellbeing initiatives 

WHSE Support 
-Maintaining safety and compliance records
-Coordinating training and inductions
-Supporting audits, inspections and corrective actions
-Assisting with incident reporting and investigations
-Return-to-work and rehabilitation administration 
Full training and support will be provided, and the roles can evolve based on the successful candidate's strengths and career aspirations. 

What We're Looking For 
You don't need experience in all areas. We're interested in people who: 
? Are highly organised and detail-oriented 
? Enjoy helping others and supporting teams 
? Communicate professionally and confidently 
? Take initiative and ownership of their work 
? Can manage multiple priorities effectively 
? Have strong computer and administrative skills 
? Bring a positive, solutions-focused attitude 

Experience That Would Be Valuable 
-Business Administration
-Human Resources
-Payroll or Recruitment
-WHSE, Compliance or Training Administration
-Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) 

Relevant qualifications or a willingness to undertake further training will be highly regarded. 

Why Join Bowhill Engineering? 
At Bowhill Engineering, we're proud of the culture we've built. We're a team that values people, growth, accountability and continuous improvement. 

Employee Benefits Include: 
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
-Health & Wellbeing Support
-Reward & Recognition Programs
-Social Events & Team Activities
-Career Development & Training Opportunities
-Modern Workplace Facilities 
-Supportive Team Environment 

What You'll Love 
-Variety and flexibility in your role
-Opportunities to learn and develop new skills
-Making a genuine impact across the business
-Working with a team that values your contribution 

Ready to Apply?

result.description: Metalwork WA Pty Ltd   Position Overview   Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and motivated Full-time Metal Fabricator to join its fabrication team in Western Australia. The successful applicant will fabricate, assemble, install, maintain, modify, and repair structural steel and other fabricated metal products by interpreting engineering drawings, preparing metal materials, and carrying out welding and fabrication activities while maintaining high standards of quality, precision, and workplace safety.    Key Responsibilities    Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.  Mark out, measure, cut, shape, and prepare metal sections, plates, pipes, and structural components.  Fabricate, assemble, and install structural steel, frames, platforms, handrails, brackets, truck bodies, and other fabricated metal products.  Fit, align, and join fabricated metal components using appropriate welding processes and fabrication techniques in accordance with engineering specifications.   Operate fabrication equipment including guillotines, press brakes, rollers, drills, saws, grinders, and other workshop machinery.  Inspect fabricated products to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.  Repair, modify, and maintain metal structures and fabricated products as required.  Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety policies and procedures.  Maintain fabrication equipment and tools in a safe operating condition and comply with workplace health and safety procedures throughout all fabrication activities.     Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   A qualification relevant to metal fabrication, engineering fabrication, boilermaking, welding, or a closely related trade equivalent to AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).  Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.  Experience in fabricating, assembling, fitting, installing, modifying, and repairing structural steel and fabricated metal products.   Competency in welding and the safe operation of fabrication machinery and associated hand and power tools.  Strong knowledge of metalworking techniques, measuring equipment, quality control processes, and workplace health and safety requirements.  Good communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment with an established Western Australian steel fabrication company.  Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience.  Opportunity to work on diverse commercial, industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects.  A professional and safety-focused workplace with modern fabrication equipment.  Ongoing opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high-quality fabrication projects.  Supportive team environment with a commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and suitability for the role.  Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company     METALWORK WA PTY LTD  is a Western Australian steel fabrication company specialising in truck body building, structural steel, and architectural steel fabrication. The company provides end-to-end fabrication services, including design, drafting, manufacturing, blasting, painting, and on-site installation for commercial, industrial, construction, and mining clients. Operating from a fully equipped workshop in Perth, Metalwork WA delivers custom metal fabrication solutions, site welding, and steel construction projects while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, workplace safety, and timely project delivery. The company has been actively operating in Australia since 2009 as a registered Australian proprietary company.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $79423-85000   Job Publish:  27-07-2026   Job Expire:  26-08-2026  Apply on:  Full-time Metal Fabricator Job here! MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 


We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 


As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 


Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.






Enterprise Architect




Care, reimagined


Design and deliver innovative learning that builds clinical digital capability


Permanent, full time role, hybrid workplace model




Make a Difference Through Digital Health.




Great healthcare technology isn't defined by the systems we buy-it's defined by how well those systems work together to support care. This pivotal role is about shaping the future digital landscape of Monash Health, connecting strategy, architecture and innovation to ensure every technology investment delivers meaningful value. As Enterprise Architect, you'll provide the architectural vision and governance that enables smarter decisions, reduces complexity and creates a more connected, sustainable and future-ready health service.





About The Role



We are now seeking an experienced and passionate Enterprise Architect to join our Design & Architecture Services team within the Digital and Information Division.



As Enterprise Architect, you will provide strategic architectural leadership across Monash Health's technology landscape, helping shape the future direction of digital investment and technology-enabled care. You will assess current capabilities, identify opportunities to simplify and rationalise the application portfolio, and ensure new technology investments align with organisational strategy, architectural standards and long-term sustainability goals. Acting as a trusted advisor to executives and technical leaders alike, you will play a critical role in defining the future-state architecture that supports Monash Health's ongoing transformation. 




What We're Looking For



You are a strategic thinker and trusted advisor who can see the bigger picture while translating complex technology landscapes into clear, practical direction. Experience in healthcare or digital health is highly regarded.

BLASK Engineering is a reputable manufacturing company specializing in structural steel. We are currently seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Metal Fabricator/Boilermaker to join our rapidly expanding and fast paced workforce. In this position, you will play a crucial role in the production process, contributing to the fabrication of high-quality metal products.
Annual Salary - $79,500 to $80,000 + superannuation 
Full Time 
Responsibilities:
•	Interpret technical drawings, and specifications to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Operate a variety of machinery and tools such as shears, press brakes, saws, grinders, and welding equipment to cut, shape, and assemble metal components.
•	Perform accurate measurements and layout work to ensure precision and conformity to specifications.
•	Select appropriate materials and metals for each project based on project requirements and specifications.
•	Have a considerable amount of knowledge in MIG welding. Knowledge in TIG and Stick desirable.
•	Conduct quality checks to verify the accuracy, completeness, and dimensional requirements of fabricated metal parts.
•	Troubleshoot and resolve issues that may arise during the fabrication process, such as equipment malfunctions or material defects.
•	Maintain a clean and organized work area, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
•	Collaborate with colleagues, including engineers and designers, to provide input on design improvements and optimize fabrication processes.
•	Keep up-to-date with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices in metal fabrication.

Qualifications:
•	Certificate III or equivalent qualification 
•	Minimum of 1 year work experience is essential 
•	Proven experience as a Metal Fabricator or similar role, with a solid understanding of metalworking principles and techniques.
•	Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings, and specifications.
•	Demonstrated proficiency in operating fabrication machinery and tools, including shears, press brakes, saws, grinders, and welding equipment.
•	Experience with various welding techniques.
•	Excellent mathematical skills, including the ability to perform precise measurements and calculations.
•	Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to producing accurate and high-quality work.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication issues effectively.
•	Knowledge of safety protocols and procedures related to metal fabrication.
•	Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

If you believe you meet the above qualifications and are ready to take on this exciting opportunity, we invite you to apply for the Metal Fabricator position at BLASK Engineering. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Please forward CV and resume through to samantha@blask.com.au
